title: IF...ELSE Statement

lines.code: # This is a simple IF...ELSE statement example
lines.explanation: This is a comment line which simply explains the function of the code below
This is a simple variable assignment statement. Here, integer '5' is assigned to the variable 'number'
This statement checks if the value of 'number' is less than 0. If this condition is true, it will go inside the 'if' statement.

If the condition of the above statement was true, it would execute this statement. But since the condition is not true (number is not less than 0), it will skip the IF statement.
Note: In this statement a comma (,) is used to combine an integer variable with the string while printing.
Since it skiped the IF statement, it will by default execute the ELSE statement.
In this statement a comma (,) is used to merge an integer variable with the string while printing.
